title: HEARTLAND Protocol App — Clinical Implementation Companion for Rural Heart Failure
description: Progressive Web Application operationalizing the HEARTLAND Protocol (Heart failure Evidence-based Access in Rural Treatment, Linking Advanced Network Delivery) for primary care-led heart failure workflows in rural and resource-limited United States settings. Version 1.2.0 adds an AI-assisted outreach demonstration to the public synthetic sandbox: a conversational daily check-in in which a large language model structures free-text answers while registered deterministic red-flag rules decide every disposition, a deterministic form fallback, simulated automated outreach calls with structured-extraction review and SBAR handoff drafts, layered usage budgets, and anonymous content-free telemetry. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Supabase. The public sandbox contains synthetic data only. This software supports implementation and evaluation; it does not establish clinical efficacy, replace clinical judgment, or authorize unsupervised patient care.
notes: Release boundary: the public sandbox uses synthetic data and is intended for demonstration and usability evaluation. Authenticated workspaces use organization-scoped access controls and are intended for controlled evaluation. This release does not establish clinical efficacy, reimbursement eligibility, HIPAA readiness, regulatory clearance, or authorization for real-PHI or unsupervised clinical use. The HEARTLAND Risk Stratification Framework remains a proposed tool under development; formal validation against clinical outcomes data is a defined research objective.
